Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa, branch feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component.

This is REWORK round 1 of 3 on Step 1 (ZimmSlideIndicator molecule) of the SFCC-236 build. The Scorer reviewed your prior work and returned REWORK with exactly three bounded fixes. Do ONLY these three — nothing else. Do not touch any file outside the 5 already in this step's manifest. Do not touch `recipeGuards.test.ts` or `recipeParts.test.ts`. Do not extract a new atom. Do not restructure the recipe's styling mechanism.

## Fix 1 — wrong semantic token on a background property
File: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSlideIndicator/zimmSlideIndicator.css.ts`, around line 48.
Currently: `background: isActive ? 'var(--zimm-color-text-default)' : 'var(--zimm-color-opacity-40)'`
Change the active branch to use `var(--zimm-color-bg-05)` instead of `var(--zimm-color-text-default)`. Both resolve to the identical value (`grey[900]`/`#191919` in `overrides/app/theme/foundation/colour.ts`) — this is a zero-visual-diff change, it just swaps a `text.*` semantic token for the semantically-correct `bg.*` token on a `background` property, matching the precedent at `overrides/app/components/footer/footer.css.ts:33` (`backgroundColor: 'var(--zimm-color-bg-05)'`). Leave the inactive branch (`var(--zimm-color-opacity-40)`) untouched — it's correct as-is. Do NOT also fix the identical pre-existing pattern in `zimmButton.css.ts:42` — that file is outside this step's manifest.

## Fix 2 — wrong Storybook category
File: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSlideIndicator/index.stories.tsx`, line 5.
Currently: `title: 'Elements/ZimmSlideIndicator'`
Change to: `title: 'Commerce/ZimmSlideIndicator'`
Rationale (for your own understanding, not to add as a comment): per `.claude/rules/components.md`'s categorisation table, this component is PDP/product-card-carousel specific, not a generic building block — every sibling PDP component in this tree (ZimmColourSwatch, ZimmColourSwatchGroup, ZimmProductContent, ZimmProductMeta, ZimmProductPrice, etc.) files under `Commerce/`.

## Fix 3 — uncitable comment references
Three comments cite an external planning document that doesn't exist anywhere in this repo (it's a private, per-session planning file that is deliberately never committed — this project's convention is that a code comment must cite something a future repo-only reader can actually reach, e.g. a Jira key, a repo doc path, or a named spec — never a private session artifact):

- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSlideIndicator/index.tsx:26` — currently references `(SFCC-236 plan §4a)`
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSlideIndicator/index.test.tsx:91` — currently references `(sole position signal on touch, see plan §4a)`
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSlideIndicator/zimmSlideIndicator.css.ts:27` — currently references `(SFCC-236 plan §4)`

For each: drop the "plan §…" fragment. The surrounding prose in each comment already states the actual rationale (that this indicator is the sole position signal on touch devices, so it must never be aria-hidden) — that rationale sentence should stay, just remove the uncitable "plan §4a"/"plan §4" pointer. If you want a ticket anchor, a bare `(SFCC-236)` Jira-key reference is fine to add in its place, but is not required — the rationale sentence standing alone is sufficient per this project's comment conventions (comments should explain WHY, and the why is already there in prose).

## After making all three fixes, verify:
```
npx tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSlideIndicator
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts
npx vitest run overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts
npx eslint overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSlideIndicator overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts
node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs
```
All must be clean / green, matching prior baseline exactly (12/12 own tests, 24/24 recipeParts, 6/6 recipeGuards, tsc clean, eslint clean, audit:tokens shows only the pre-existing unrelated footer.css.ts finding).

Confirm via `git status --porcelain` that only the same 5 files from before show any diff — nothing new. Do NOT stage or commit. Report exactly what changed in each of the 3 files (before/after for each fix) and confirm all verification commands passed.

4	 * Recipe for the touch-only PDP/card image position indicator — a 1px hairline strip, one
5	 * segment per image, the current position picked out by colour. Figma node 40002536:7957
6	 * ("Slide indicator") confirms only the strip's height (1px, flush to the image's bottom edge)
7	 * and that it is NOT floating dots; per-segment width/gap and the exact colour pairing are not

17	 *     already-agreed contract, not a literal shape description).
18	 */

20	  parts: ['root', 'dot'],
